blast_radius.why: First job of the NIGHTLY folder, which the client says must not break: it waits on an external feed and its done signal releases JOBB.

units.driving_fact: JOBA starts only when condition EXTERNAL-FEED exists, which nothing in the tree sets, and it sets JOBA-DONE for JOBB.

blast_radius.why: Second job of the NIGHTLY folder: it must run after JOBA, it deletes JOBA-DONE, and it publishes JOBB-DONE to a consumer outside the tree.

units.driving_fact: JOBB waits for JOBA-DONE, then removes that condition and sets JOBB-DONE, so its rerun and restart behavior lives in the scheduler, not in the job.
